result.title: Online Temporal Rotations for 2 Bit KV-Cache Quantization in Video Diffusion Transformers
result.summary: Video diffusion transformers reuse key--value (KV) caches across denoising steps, which quickly becomes a bottleneck for long video generation. We find that quantizing temporally distant cache vectors leads to a large range and high quantization error, but that nearby video tokens in the KV-cache share a persistent pattern per channel. These patterns also vary across videos, motivating rotations that are adapted to each video's unique cache. We propose Temporal Rotation Quantization (TRQ), a method that rotates frames in the cache that are adjacent in time before quantization. For each block of temporally adjacent cache vectors, TRQ fits an orthogonal transform that maps the block's per-channel means to a vector that is close to a constant across channels. To keep the quantization format lightweight, we parameterize this rotation as a tree of $2 \times 2$ planar rotations, each stored with only two bits, followed by a fixed Hadamard transform shared across all blocks. The rotations are fit without gradients or changes to model weights, and we prove that a simple greedy fit is globally optimal for our 'mean-flattening' objective. The transforms are fit online for each new video, and we release fused Triton kernels to make this process efficient at inference. At 2-bit precision and matched compression, TRQ improves VBench subject consistency over the state-of-the-art method QVG from 90.38 to 92.02 on LongCat-Video-13B and from 86.33 to 87.61 on HY-WorldPlay-8B, as well as improving other metrics.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究长视频扩散 Transformer 的 KV-cache 2-bit 量化，提出 TRQ：对时间相邻的缓存向量分块在线拟合正交变换（参数化为 2-bit 平面旋转树加固定 Hadamard），把逐通道均值压平后再量化以降低误差。
AI.relevance_reason: 其按视频在线拟合、面向缓存分块的旋转可提供核查线索：缓存与位置相关的 latent 几何如何影响信息保留，以及轻度正交变换能否在不改动权重下稳定内部状态；但论文目标是生成效率而非推理状态，迁移价值需自行判断。
